# Getting Started

This page walks through the first ten minutes with widget, a fictional command line tool used only as test data.

## Requirements

Widget runs on any machine with a recent shell. It needs about fifty megabytes of disk space and no network access after installation.

## First project

Create an empty folder and run `widget init` inside it. The command writes a configuration file with sensible defaults and prints the next steps.

```sh
mkdir demo && cd demo
widget init
```

## Next steps

Read the configuration reference to adjust the defaults, then look at the command overview to learn the daily workflow.
